basics.name: Connor L. Box
basics.label: Computational Surface Chemist
basics.summary: Computational chemist with expertise in electronic structure methods and molecular dynamics. Developer in the FHI-aims code with experience in electronic friction, electron-phonon coupling, and density functional perturbation theory. Experienced in high-performance computing and collaborative scientific software projects.
